twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabled: On. Every sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabled: Off. Protect your account with a second factor.
twoFactor.passwordDescription: For your security we need your current password.
twoFactor.scanDescription: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key by hand.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.backupDescription: Use these codes to sign in when your phone is missing. Each code works once. You see them only now.
twoFactor.verifyDescription: Enter the current code from the app to finish the setup.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: You are signed in here right now.
sessions.revoked: The device has been signed out.
sessions.othersRevoked: All other devices have been signed out.
sessions.revokeFailed: The device could not be signed out. Please try again.
sessions.notFresh: For your security, the signed-in devices are shown only until a day after your sign-in. Sign in again to see them.
